title: Maximum Multiplication Score
summary: Given an integer array a of size 4 and an array b of at least 4 integers, select 4 indices i0, i1, i2, and i3 from b where i0 < i1 < i2 < i3.
statement: Given an integer array a of size 4 and an array b of at least 4 integers, select 4 indices i0, i1, i2, and i3 from b where i0 < i1 < i2 < i3. Calculate the score as a[0]*b[i0] + a[1]*b[i1] + a[2]*b[i2] + a[3]*b[i3]. Find the maximum possible score.
constraints: a has exactly four integers and b has at least four; values may be negative.
Choose indices i0<i1<i2<i3 from b and sum a[j]*b[ij].
hints: After scanning a prefix of b, only how many coefficients have been assigned matters.
Keep the best score for selecting exactly zero through four indices.
Process states backward so each b value is used at most once; assign it to the next coefficient.
Skip/take transitions cover every ordered four-index choice, and exact-count states preserve feasibility with negatives.
editorial: Skip/take transitions cover every ordered four-index choice, and exact-count states preserve feasibility with negatives.
